title: Computational exploration of hydrogen storage potential in Mg2LiXH6 (X = Ti, V) hydrides via DFT and AIMD simulations
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26896-26908
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01881E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Malik Muhammad Asif Iqbal, Muhammad Kaleem, Amna Nasir, Asif Nawaz Khan, Muhammad Abaidullah
DFT, phonon, and AIMD investigations reveal that Mg2LiXH6 (X = Ti, V) double perovskite hydrides possess excellent structural stability, favorable dehydrogenation temperatures, and achieve >5 wt% H2 capacity for solid-state hydrogen storage.
